company.name: Nubank
company.description: Nubank is a large digital banking platform founded in 2013 that has grown rapidly in Latin America and serves over 130 million customers; it is widely cited as a disruptive challenger to incumbent banks in the region (E3, E4).

business_model.value_proposition: Digital-first banking platform that offers low-friction accounts and financial services to challenge traditional incumbents in Latin America (E3, E4).
distribution_channels: mobile/digital channels (implied by digital banking platform) (E3)

incumbents: traditional incumbent banks in Latin America (E4)
substitutes: traditional banks and legacy financial services (E4)
